mentions.name: Open-source Android launcher
mentions.description: A free and open-source Android launcher similar to Smart Launcher, built to fill the FOSS gap on degoogled Android phones.
mentions.problem: Proprietary launchers were among the few non-FOSS apps left on a degoogled phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been making an android launcher, similar to the smart launcher but free and open source

one of the few apps not FOSS on my degoogled phone, thought it was time to fix that
